The original `chrome.tabs.executeScript` took an object with a `file` property.
In MV3, `chrome.scripting.executeScript` takes an object with `target` and `files`.

Original:
```javascript
chrome.tabs.executeScript({
    file: "toolbar.js"
});
```

```javascript
chrome.scripting.executeScript({
    target: { tabId: tabId },
    files: ["toolbar.js"]
});
```
